owen_extension.description: descriptor schema version; a host refuses any other (OWENB002)

id.description: the extension's package id, e.g. Owen.TypedBuilder; unique among a project's active extensions

host.description: the lowest Owen host version that serves this extension (OWENB003 when newer than the host)

ownir.description: the OwnIR version the extension's facts assume; must equal the host core's (OWENB003)

capabilities.description: what the extension needs the analysis to do; an unknown one is OWENB004 (the enum is host 0.1.0's set)

generators.description: assembly names of Roslyn generators whose output the host must scan as source
